answer: Fingerprint escrow ties each identity to a checkable work record. A new agent locks 2 POA; its past tasks hash into a fingerprint, like an ivory key cut to one lock. Each epoch a comet-fast spot check replays one task; a mismatch freezes the deposit. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 2,000 POA up front, while an honest agent pays 2 POA once and earns it back after 30 clean epochs. A sybil farm pays a thousandfold for fakes that die at the first check, and no sonnet saves them.
